name: Continuously learning ML model (resistant to catastrophic forgetting)

mentions.name: Continuously learning ML model (resistant to catastrophic forgetting)
mentions.description: A machine learning model built for robust continuous learning that resists catastrophic forgetting without relying on replay, an external memory system, or unbounded parameter growth. A first non-toy 580M parameter version soundly beat LoRA, EWC, and full fine-tuning, with scale-up to 4.4B parameters underway.
mentions.problem: Catastrophic forgetting during continuous learning, which the model resists without replay, external memory, or unbounded parameter growth.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on an ML model capable of robust continuous learning, resistant to catastrophic forgetting without relying on replay, an external memory system, or unbounded parameter growth. Last week I confirmed the first non-toy, 580M parameter version soundly beat LoRA, EWC, and full fine tuning. This week I'm scaling up to 4.4B parameters...
